title: Gaps, isolated points, and the origin of the ray in the one-dimensional Dirichlet spectrum
summary: We study the one-dimensional Dirichlet spectrum and obtain new results concerning the origin $μ$ of the ray contained in the spectrum and its isolated points. First, we prove the improved upper bound $μ\leq (448875+1611\sqrt{67773})/46982 = 18.4809\ldots$. We also exhibit an explicit gap $(L,R)$ in the Dirichlet spectrum, which yields the improved lower bound $μ\geq R = 5.9596\ldots$. The proof of the lower bound includes an exact computer-assisted finite search over admissible continued-fraction words.
